title: Oblong, not rectangular. Watch yourself!
text:
Oblong, not rectangular. Watch yourself!. Nowhere on this page did it say the tablecloth was oblong. The picture is of a CORNER for pete's sake. I ordered two 60x84's assuming they were rectangular. I needed them for three days from now, so now I'm screwed. They offered me "instant refunds" and I don't have to send them back, not that I even want them. I tripled checked to make sure I was buying the right tablecloth, and for nothing.

Otherwise, they look very nice through the package. Love the colors. Sure wish I could use them.
